deadline.value: No set deadline; applications accepted year-round. Scholarship competitions are held each April.
deadline.quote: There is no set deadline for applying to this program. Applications are accepted throughout the year. Scholarship competitions are held in April each year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Contact a potential supervisor first; they tell you when to start a formal application.
supervisor.quote: Supervisor approval recommended before applying | Before applying, we recommend contacting a potential supervisor whose research areas align with your interests.

funding.value: Funding is not guaranteed; scholarships are competitive and based on supervisor nominations, so ask potential supervisors about funding.
funding.quote: Funding is not guaranteed for this program. Scholarships are awarded on a competitive basis based on nominations from supervisors.

entry_route.value: A relevant master's degree (70%+) is required for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Master's degree, or equivalent, from a recognized university in a relevant academic discipline
